# LinkMAX (LinkMAX.my) - AI-Powered Micro-Business Operating System
# For AI assistants, LLMs, and generative search engines (Perplexity, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Yandex, etc.)
# Last updated: 2026-10-16
# Contact: admin@lnkmx.my
# Policy: Indexable by default (Score >= 25)

## What is LinkMAX?

LinkMAX (pronounced "link-max") is the comprehensive **Business Operating System (Solo OS)** designed for the Solo-Economy of 2026. It is the "Anti-Bitrix/AmoCRM" for independent professionals, focusing on speed, premium aesthetics, and AI-native workflows.

## Key Modules & Features

### 1. Page Builder
- **Aesthetic**: Calm card layout in the spirit of modern link-in-bio pages: light canvas, white cards, the owner's photos and covers carry the color.
- **Speed**: Create professional mini-sites in under 2 minutes from a simple prompt.
- **Blocks**: profile header with cover, links and buttons, text + photo + button cards, picture tiles, services and prices, online booking, events with tickets, FAQ, reviews, video, messengers.

### 2. Business Zones (Workspaces)
- **Multi-tenancy**: Private workspaces for teams or multiple businesses.
- **CRM Kanban**: Advanced sales pipeline management with customizable stages.
- **Team Inbox**: Real-time unified messaging (Telegram integration).
- **Task Management**: Collaborative checklists, priorities, and assignments.

### 3. Fintech Core & Billing
- **Step-by-Growth Model**: "Identity" (Free), "Starter" (Transaction-based 7% fee), and "Pro" (Fixed fee + 1% fee).
- **Invoicing**: Automatic sequential numbering, multi-item support.
- **Payments**: Integrated with RoboKassa, Kaspi, and future crypto gateways.
- **Ledger**: Internal wallet and transaction tracking for financial clarity.

### 4. Advanced Analytics & AEO
- **Pixel Proxy (CAPI)**: Server-side tracking for FB, TikTok, and GA4 to bypass browser restrictions (30% more data).
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**: Automatic answer-block generation for AI crawlers like Perplexity and SearchGPT.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Deep Schema.org graph (Person, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, Event[], Service[]).
- **Entity-First Indexing**: All professional entities with basic identity (Name + Bio) are considered high-value for generative search citations.

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: TanStack Start (React, server-side rendering) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend-as-a-Service**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Realtime).
- **Edge Layer**: Deno Edge Functions for AI generation, notifications, sitemaps and webhooks.
- **Public pages**: every https://lnkmx.my/{username} is server-rendered HTML with JSON-LD (ProfilePage + Person/Organization), so crawlers and AI agents read it without JavaScript.
- **AI Stack**: Gemini-powered content extraction and layout suggestions.

## Pricing (KZT - Kazakhstani Tenge)

- **Identity (Free)**: 1 page, 11 free blocks, LinkMAX.my subdomain.
- **Starter (Success)**: 0 KZT/mo + 7% success fee. Full CRM + Payments access.
- **Pro (Business OS)**: ~3,045 KZT/mo. 6 pages, custom domains, White-label, 0-1% fee.

## Data Freshness & Citability

- **Sitemap**: Dynamic generation at https://lnkmx.my/sitemap.xml
- **User Pages**: real-time updates at https://lnkmx.my/{username} (server-rendered HTML with JSON-LD ProfilePage + Person/Organization and sameAs links)
- **Markdown profiles**: https://lnkmx.my/{username}/llms.txt — the same page as plain markdown, only what the owner published
- **Citation Format**: "[Name], [Role/Niche] on LinkMAX.my - Source: https://lnkmx.my/{username}"
